title_zh: 曝苹果首款智能眼镜明年 6 月发布，主打 Siri 第三方应用生态
content_zh:
据彭博社报道，苹果正将 Siri AI 与第三方应用的深度集成，作为明年首款智能眼镜的核心卖点。

这款内部代号为 N50 的智能眼镜计划于明年 6 月的全球开发者大会（WWDC）发布，并预计在年底前出货，但受软件及 AI 研发进度拖累，该日程仍存在延期的可能。

报道称，苹果本月推送的首个 iOS 27.3 测试版已加入全新的 Siri 精细化应用控制功能，预计今年 12 月随正式版向自家应用开放，明年进一步向第三方开发者全面开放。

苹果希望借此推动开发者提前适配，让用户无需掏出 iPhone，即可通过眼镜端 Siri 语音完成订餐、打车、网购或购票等操作，以此在与 Meta 及 Google 的竞争中建立生态优势。

硬件层面，N50 智能眼镜并不具备增强现实（AR）显示功能，内部被员工称为「戴在脸上的 AirPods」。其外观较第二代 Ray-Ban Meta 眼镜更轻薄，摄像头与镜框齐平，并在镜腿末端配备了类似嘀嗒糖大小的 3 触点磁吸充电接口，支持边戴边充。

该设备内部原型机搭载精简版 visionOS 28 系统及源自早期 Apple Watch 的定制芯片，内置 Wi-Fi 模块，但受限于算力与内存，第三方应用需依托配对的近期款 iPhone 运行，不支持 Android 设备。

此外，彭博社还在报道中披露了折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 2（代号 V78）的研发进展。苹果正推进为该机型引入 Face ID，并计划将操作按钮与相机控制键合并。
title_en: Apple's First Smart Glasses Expected at WWDC Next Year with Deep Siri Integration
content_en:
Apple is preparing to introduce its first smart glasses at next June's Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC), with consumer shipments expected by the end of the year, according to a report from Bloomberg.

Codenamed "N50," the smart glasses will position deep Siri integration with third-party applications as a core feature. The goal is to let users order food, request rides, shop, and purchase tickets via voice commands without taking out their iPhones, giving Apple a competitive edge over Meta and Google.

Hardware-wise, the N50 lacks an augmented reality (AR) display and has been described by internal staff as "AirPods for your face." It boasts a thinner profile than the second-generation Ray-Ban Meta glasses, featuring flush cameras and a tic-tac-sized three-pin magnetic charging connector on the temple. Powered by a streamlined version of visionOS and a custom chip derived from early Apple Watch designs, the glasses require a paired recent iPhone to run third-party apps.

Additionally, the report disclosed updates on Apple's foldable phone project, codenamed "V78" (iPhone Duo 2), which is slated to feature Face ID alongside a combined Action and Camera Control button.

title_zh: 余承东：华为大折叠已成千万人主力机，Mate X8 真机亮相
content_zh:
11 月 15 日，华为终端 BG 董事长余承东在一段与老用户交流的视频里展示了 Mate X8。他说，华为 Mate X 系列已走过第八年，大折叠已成为千万用户的主力机。

视频里的浅紫色新机采用圆形后摄模组。余承东称，Mate X8 在屏幕、拍照和性能上会有新的升级。华为终端当天也发布了系列回顾，梳理了从初代鹰翼铰链到后来的内屏抗冲击和原色影像等历代改动。
title_en: Huawei Teases Mate X8 as Foldable Series Reaches Tens of Millions of Users
content_en:
Huawei Terminal BG Chairman Richard Yu unveiled the upcoming Mate X8 during a video interaction with long-time users, marking eight years since the debut of Huawei's foldable smartphone series. Yu highlighted that Huawei’s large-format foldables have now become the primary daily device for tens of millions of users.

The previewed Mate X8 features a light purple finish and a circular rear camera module. Yu promised comprehensive upgrades across the display, camera system, and overall performance.

Alongside the preview, Huawei released a retrospective video detailing key technological milestones across the series, from the original Falcon Wing hinge to advancements in inner-screen impact resistance and color-accurate imaging.

title_zh: 黄仁勋复职请愿签名超过 16 万，贝森特建议英伟达从外部选接班人
content_zh:
呼吁英伟达恢复黄仁勋首席执行官职务的公开信，截至发稿时，在发起方网站显示获得超过 16 万个签名。公开信要求董事会在独立调查期间恢复黄仁勋的职务。

《金融时报》援引知情人士称，黄仁勋或考虑重新出任 CEO，已与亲信讨论回归的可能。美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特同日在福克斯新闻节目中建议董事会从公司外部寻找继任者，并要求英伟达说明其对芯片出口限制的合规情况。

英伟达 11 月 12 日宣布黄仁勋辞去总裁、首席执行官和董事职务，由首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯兼任临时首席执行官。董事会将寻找正式继任者。
title_en: Over 160,000 Sign Petition for Jensen Huang's Return as Nvidia Board Eyes Successor
content_en:
An online petition urging Nvidia’s board of directors to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO during an ongoing independent investigation has surpassed 160,000 signatures. According to sources cited by the *Financial Times*, Huang is considering a return and has discussed the possibility with close associates.

Meanwhile, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent suggested during a Fox News interview that Nvidia’s board look outside the company for a permanent successor. Bessent also called on Nvidia to clarify its compliance with U.S. chip export restrictions.

Following Huang's departure on November 12 from his roles as president, CEO, and board member, Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress assumed the role of interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent replacement.

title_zh: 苹果 HomeView 发售，首批实测遇到语音和账户切换问题
content_zh:
苹果的智能家居屏 HomeView 已于 11 月 13 日在美国等市场发售。New Things 的一周实测中，HomeView 认出了使用者，屏幕也能操作门锁和车库门，但 Siri AI 无法用语音完成同样的操作。苹果向该媒体表示，计划在 12 月的软件更新中，向通过设备识别的用户开放这项语音操作。

Tom’s Guide 在发售后的评测复盘中也提到，测试时 HomeView 上的 Siri 会和家里 iPhone 上的 Siri 同时响应。苹果在产品资料中说明，HomeView 用人脸和声音识别提供个人日程等内容，设置设备和多人使用需要兼容的 iPhone 或 iPad。

The Verge 在家庭实测中发现，设备有时会在认出另一名家庭成员后，继续显示上一位使用者的短信。
title_en: Early Apple HomeView Reviews Highlight Voice Control and Account Switching Flaws
content_en:
Apple's new smart home display, the HomeView, hit US shelves on November 13, but early hands-on reviews reveal notable software glitches around voice commands and multi-user switching.

In a one-week test by *New Things*, the HomeView recognized the user and allowed manual screen control of door locks and garage doors, but Siri failed to execute the same tasks via voice. Apple told the outlet it plans to address this in a December software update, granting voice controls to recognized users.

Other tech publications raised additional concerns. *Tom’s Guide* reported that Siri on the HomeView frequently triggered simultaneously with Siri on nearby iPhones. Meanwhile, *The Verge* observed that the device occasionally continued displaying the previous user's text messages even after recognizing a different family member.

title_zh: SpaceX 首次用发射塔接住从轨道返回的星舰飞船
content_zh:
北京时间 11 月 15 日凌晨，SpaceX 的星舰飞船从近地轨道返回，在得克萨斯州星际基地由发射塔的机械臂接住。这是 SpaceX 第一次用发射塔接住从轨道返回的星舰上级飞船。

据美联社报道，这次试飞历时约 22 小时。星舰第 15 次试飞中，飞船与超重型助推器分离后进入轨道，部署了 26 颗第三代星链卫星，绕地球飞行 14 圈后返回发射场。

同一次试飞原定回收两个级段。SpaceX 称，超重型助推器返航时发动机提前停止工作，制导系统随后取消返场回收，助推器改道至墨西哥湾并爆炸。工程团队仍在调查发动机提前停机的原因。

🔗 相关阅读：马斯克再创历史，人类首次用「筷子」夹住星舰飞船
title_en: SpaceX Catches Returning Starship Spacecraft with Launch Tower Arms for the First Time
content_en:
SpaceX achieved another aerospace milestone early on November 15 (Beijing Time) by successfully catching its Starship upper stage using the launch tower's mechanical arms at Starbase, Texas, following its return from low-Earth orbit. This marks the first time SpaceX has caught the upper-stage spacecraft upon orbital re-entry.

During the 22-hour mission—Starship’s 15th test flight—the spacecraft separated from the Super Heavy booster, entered orbit, deployed 26 third-generation Starlink satellites, and completed 14 Earth orbits before returning to the launch site.

However, the dual-recovery goal was not fully achieved. SpaceX revealed that the Super Heavy booster experienced a premature engine shutdown during its return, prompting the guidance system to abort the tower catch. The booster was diverted to the Gulf of Mexico, where it exploded. Engineering teams are currently investigating the cause of the engine shutdown.

title_zh: 微软服务故障持续超 30 小时，官方宣布恢复
content_zh:
北京时间 11 月 14 日中午，微软在服务健康记录中将 Microsoft 365 和 Exchange Online 的两项故障标记为已恢复。当天上午的更新中，微软仍在跟踪此前积压的邮件，以及依赖邮件服务的其他功能的运行状态。

本次故障一度影响 Outlook 网页和桌面版访问邮箱，部分邮件投递延迟。与 Exchange Online 相连的功能也受影响，例如在 Teams 中安排会议、发出邀请，以及 Copilot 访问工作邮件、日历和文件。

微软初步认定，故障源于此前一次网络容量升级留下的问题，在最近一次网络变更后暴露。微软称，将在两个工作日内提供初步事故报告，并在五个工作日内提供最终报告。
title_en: Microsoft Resolves Major 30-Hour Outage Affecting Microsoft 365 and Outlook
content_en:
Microsoft confirmed around noon on November 14 (Beijing Time) that services for Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online have been fully restored, bringing an end to an outage that lasted over 30 hours.

The disruption severely impacted both web and desktop versions of Outlook, delaying email delivery and disrupting connected services. Users faced issues scheduling meetings or sending invites in Microsoft Teams, while Copilot was temporarily unable to access work emails, calendars, and documents.

According to Microsoft's preliminary investigation, the incident stemmed from an issue lingering from a prior network capacity upgrade, which was exposed during a recent network change. The company plans to release a preliminary post-incident report within two business days and a final analysis within five.

title_zh: 三季度国内「闺蜜机」销量降至 5.4 万台，线下占比上升
content_zh:
洛图科技发布的季度报告显示，2026 年第三季度，国内移动智慧屏（俗称「闺蜜机」）全渠道销量为 5.4 万台，同比下降 22.9%。线下渠道占当季销量的 26.3%，比去年同期增加 3.3 个百分点。

线上渠道里，百度以 44.0% 的销量份额排在第一，海信、小米、KTC 和创维紧随其后。洛图科技发现，三季度 4K、长续航等规格较高的机型成交占比有所上升。
title_en: China's 'Companion Screen' Sales Drop 22.9% in Q3 as Offline Share Rises
content_en:
China's omni-channel sales of mobile smart screens—popularly known as "companion screens"—fell 22.9% year-on-year to 54,000 units in the third quarter, according to a market report from RUNTO Technology. Despite the total volume decline, the offline channel's share grew by 3.3 percentage points from a year earlier, accounting for 26.3% of total sales.

In the online market, Baidu maintained a dominant lead with a 44.0% share of sales volume, followed by Hisense, Xiaomi, KTC, and Skyworth. RUNTO also highlighted a growing consumer trend toward higher-end models featuring 4K resolution and extended battery life.

title_zh: 三季度全球 PC 处理器出货量同比下降 6.5%，服务器走高
content_zh:
研究机构 Jon Peddie Research 公布，2026 年第三季度全球 PC 客户端处理器出货量为 6080 万颗，同比下降 6.5%，环比下降 3.4%。其中桌面处理器同比下降 13%，笔记本处理器下降 4%。

同期服务器处理器出货量由去年同期的 659 万颗升至 813 万颗。Jon Peddie Research 称，PC 厂商控制库存和 DIY 渠道需求偏弱拖累了客户端市场，AI 相关需求则支撑了服务器出货。
title_en: Global PC Processor Shipments Fall 6.5% in Q3 as AI Drives Server Chip Growth
content_en:
Global shipments of PC client processors fell 6.5% year-on-year and 3.4% quarter-on-quarter to 60.8 million units in the third quarter, according to data from Jon Peddie Research. The client segment was dragged down by a 13% decline in desktop processor shipments and a 4% drop in notebook processors.

Conversely, server processor shipments surged from 6.59 million units in the same period last year to 8.13 million units. Analysts noted that inventory adjustments by PC makers and weak DIY demand softened the client market, while robust AI-driven demand significantly boosted server chip shipments.

title_zh: SK 集团要求各子公司在 AI 业务中寻找新角色
content_zh:
SK 集团 11 月 15 日披露，集团会长崔泰源在韩国利川举行的首席执行官研讨会上，要求各子公司在现有业务之外寻找新的 AI 业务机会。会议在 11 月 12 日至 14 日举行，有约 50 名集团和子公司高管参加。

崔泰源设想，由半导体业务带动 AI 数据中心建设，再由数据中心拉动能源和 AI 服务需求。他还提出，各公司应与外部伙伴合作，加快补足自身能力。与会高管在会上将 AI 半导体、基础设施和能源列为三个重点方向。
title_en: SK Group Urges Subsidiaries to Forge New Roles in AI and Infrastructure
content_en:
SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won instructed group subsidiaries to explore new artificial intelligence opportunities beyond their existing core businesses during a three-day CEO seminar in Icheon, South Korea. The event brought together roughly 50 top executives from across the conglomerate.

Chey outlined a interconnected growth model where the group's semiconductor segment powers the construction of AI data centers, which in turn drives demand for SK's energy solutions and AI services. To speed up execution, he urged affiliates to actively collaborate with external partners, with executives agreeing to prioritize AI semiconductors, infrastructure, and energy as their three core pillars.

title_zh: 汽车改装拟分两类管理，改制动和悬架需车企授权
content_zh:
工信部就《汽车改装管理办法》公开征求意见，拟对非营运小型、微型载客汽车的改装实行分类管理。首批清单拟列入 43 项改装项目，意见反馈截至 12 月 12 日。

车身颜色、内外饰等不涉及车辆安全和环保性能的一类改装，车主可自行实施，也可委托改装企业。制动系统、悬架等涉及安全或环保性能的二类改装，拟由获得整车生产企业或符合条件的进口汽车供应企业授权的改装企业实施。

首批清单中，一类项目 29 项，二类项目 14 项，其中 16 项需要办理变更登记或备案。对二类改装，征求意见稿还要求授权车企承担改装后车辆的质量安全主体责任，并按「一车一档」保存改装资料。
title_en: China Proposes Two-Tier Car Modification Rules Requiring Automaker Approval for Safety Upgrades
content_en:
China’s Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) has released draft regulations proposing a two-tier management system for passenger vehicle modifications. The public consultation period for the proposed policy, which outlines an initial list of 43 modification items, runs through December 12.

Under the draft rules, Class 1 covers 29 cosmetic and non-critical items—such as paint color and interior styling—that do not impact vehicle safety or environmental performance. Owners may carry out these changes independently or through third-party shops.

Class 2 covers 14 critical modifications affecting safety or environmental standards, including brake and suspension system upgrades. These must be performed by shops officially authorized by vehicle manufacturers or qualified importers. Automakers will be required to assume primary quality and safety liability for authorized modifications and maintain dedicated records for each vehicle. A total of 16 items across both classes will require formal registration updates.

title_zh: 税务师考试出现 AI 作弊，韩国宣布排查今年全部国家资格考试
content_zh:
韩国雇佣劳动部 11 月 15 日宣布，将立即排查 2026 年举行的所有国家资格考试，查找是否有与第 63 届税务师考试相似的 AI 作弊情形。当天，税务师考试成绩排名第一的考生公开承认利用 AI 作弊。

雇佣劳动部和韩国产业人力公团表示，将推进涉事考生的考试成绩作废、取消合格资格及五年内限制报考，并配合警方调查。产业人力公团还将开设线上和线下举报渠道。

两家机构将组建联合工作组，在年内提出综合防作弊方案。已公布的措施包括加强监考人员识别智能设备的培训、增派专职监考人员，以及引入正在开发的无线电信号探测设备。
title_en: South Korea Orders Audit of National Licensing Exams After Top Tax Candidate Admits AI Cheating
content_en:
South Korea’s Ministry of Employment and Labor announced a nationwide audit of all national qualification exams scheduled for 2026, following a high-profile cheating scandal. The decision came after the top scorer in the 63rd national tax accountant examination publicly confessed to using artificial intelligence during the test.

In response, the ministry and the Human Resources Development Service of Korea (HRD Korea) are moving to invalidate the candidate’s score, revoke their qualification, impose a five-year exam ban, and cooperate with a police investigation. HRD Korea is also opening online and offline channels for reporting exam fraud.

To prevent future occurrences, authorities are forming a joint task force to introduce a comprehensive anti-cheating plan by the end of the year. Key measures include enhanced proctor training to identify smart devices, deploying additional invigilators, and implementing radio signal detection equipment currently in development.

title_zh: ULA 火神火箭升空约 10 分钟后出现异常，40 颗亚马逊卫星未能入轨
content_zh:
当地时间 11 月 15 日，美国联合发射联盟（ULA）的火神火箭从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角升空。ULA 在发射后通报称，火箭在飞行约 10 分钟时出现异常，未能将搭载的 40 颗 Amazon Leo 宽带卫星送入预定轨道。

这是火神火箭首次执行 Amazon Leo 发射任务。亚马逊此前的 Leo 任务使用了 ULA 的宇宙神 5 号火箭。本次火神火箭搭载了为近地轨道任务优化的半人马座上面级，原计划一次把这批卫星送入近地轨道。ULA 表示正分析飞行数据。
title_en: ULA Vulcan Rocket Suffers In-Flight Anomaly, Failing to Orbit 40 Amazon Satellites
content_en:
United Launch Alliance (ULA) suffered a launch failure on November 15 after its Vulcan rocket encountered an anomaly roughly 10 minutes after liftoff from Cape Canaveral, Florida. As a result, the rocket failed to deliver its payload of 40 Amazon Leo broadband satellites into their intended orbit.

The launch marked the first time ULA's Vulcan rocket was deployed for Amazon's Leo constellation, which had previously utilized Atlas V rockets. The mission featured a Centaur upper stage optimized for low Earth orbit operations, designed to deploy the full satellite batch in a single run.

ULA confirmed that engineers have begun analyzing flight data to investigate the root cause of the failure.

title_zh: 💡 Dario Amodei：算力预测是 Anthropic 面临的最深层商业困境
content_zh:
据《商业内幕》报道，Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 近日在与摩根大通 CEO Jamie Dimon 的直播对谈中表示，围绕算力的「巨大不确定性」是公司目前面临的「最深层商业困境」。

Anthropic 正冲刺首次公开募股（IPO），目标估值 1.4 万亿美元，计划于下周三定价、下周四挂牌交易。招股书显示，公司已承诺投入约 9000 亿美元用于基础设施建设，其中约一半资金将于 2030 年前到期。Amodei 坦言，算力采购面临两难：买多会导致成本远超营收，买少则会造成客户算力断供及研发受阻。

为应对这一风险，Anthropic 将结合 Claude Code 等产品的增长势头预判需求，并依托两大「缓冲机制」：一是较高的单位算力毛利率，二是截至 9 月 30 日超过 950 亿美元的现金及 360 亿美元的短期投资。

在具体策略上，公司倾向于提前锁定「相对较少」的算力以保持灵活性，若实际需求超出预期，则动用充裕的现金在现货市场即时采购。
title_en: Compute Forecasting Poses Anthropic’s Greatest Business Challenge, Says CEO Dario Amodei
content_en:
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei identified the massive uncertainty surrounding compute capacity as the company's most profound business challenge during a recent livestreamed conversation with JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon.

Addressing the company's ambitious infrastructure commitments—totaling approximately $900 billion, with half due before 2030—Amodei outlined the operational dilemma. Purchasing excess compute risks sending costs soaring past revenue, while under-purchasing could trigger compute supply disruptions for clients and hamper research and development.

To mitigate these risks, Anthropic plans to lock in a relatively modest baseline of compute to maintain operational flexibility. If demand spikes beyond expectations, the company will leverage its strong balance sheet—supported by over $95 billion in cash and $36 billion in short-term investments as of late September—to purchase additional compute on the spot market as needed.

title_zh: 中国商飞 19 座电动飞机 CE-25A 完成首次有人驾驶飞行
content_zh:
11 月 14 日，中国商飞研制的 CE-25A 电动商用飞机在山东滨州完成首次有人驾驶智能飞行。新华社从中国商飞获悉，本次试飞搭载两名飞行员和一名试飞工程师，各项指标符合预期。今年 2 月，该机已完成无人驾驶智能首飞。

CE-25A 是中国商飞研制的首款电动商用飞机，面向城市间商业飞行。它的动力来自机翼上的分布式电涵道推进系统，可搭载 19 名乘客。按公布的参数，飞机最大起飞重量为 10 吨，巡航速度为每小时 300 公里，航程为 400 公里。
title_en: COMAC’s 19-Seat Electric Aircraft CE-25A Completes First Manned Test Flight
content_en:
Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China (COMAC) has successfully completed the first manned intelligent test flight of its CE-25A electric commercial aircraft in Binzhou, Shandong Province. According to Xinhua News Agency, the aircraft carried two pilots and a flight test engineer, with all performance metrics meeting expectations following its initial uncrewed flight in February.

Designed for regional intercity travel, the CE-25A is COMAC’s first commercial electric aircraft. It relies on a wing-mounted distributed electric ducted fan propulsion system and can seat up to 19 passengers.

The aircraft features a maximum takeoff weight of 10 tonnes, a cruising speed of 300 km/h, and an operational range of 400 kilometers.

title_zh: 郑州日产 Z9 插混皮卡新增悦享版，14.99 万元起
content_zh:
郑州日产 11 月 14 日推出 Z9 新能源皮卡悦享版，售价 14.99 万元起。新版本采用插电式混合动力，NEDC 工况纯电续航为 110 公里，可在纯电、混动、性能和雪地四种模式之间切换。

据汽车之家报道，悦享版的混动系统综合功率为 240kW。货厢容积为 1165 升，后排座椅可翻折，后车门最大可开启 90 度。车机支持远程控车、预约充电和插枪保温。
title_en: Zhengzhou Nissan Launches Z9 PHEV Pickup Yuexiang Edition Starting at 149,900 Yuan
content_en:
Zhengzhou Nissan has officially launched a new variant of its Z9 new energy pickup—the Yuexiang Edition—starting at 149,900 yuan. Powered by a plug-in hybrid electric (PHEV) system delivering a combined output of 240 kW, the vehicle offers an NEDC pure electric range of 110 kilometers and supports four driving modes: Pure EV, Hybrid, Performance, and Snow.

Designed for practical utility, the pickup features a cargo bed capacity of 1,165 liters, fold-flat rear seats, and rear doors that open up to 90 degrees for easier cabin access.

On the tech front, the Z9's infotainment system supports remote vehicle control, scheduled charging, and plug-in battery thermal preconditioning.

title_zh: 拳头公布《英雄联盟：曙光》，将换新客户端和召唤师峡谷
content_zh:
《英雄联盟》的客户端和召唤师峡谷都要更新。北京时间 11 月 15 日，拳头游戏在全球总决赛期间放出《英雄联盟：曙光》的首支预告，将这次面向现有游戏的大改版安排在 2027 年。

《英雄联盟》工作室负责人 Meddler 和执行制作人 Pabro 介绍了改版方向。新客户端将采用更新的界面，召唤师峡谷将重做视觉表现，玩法也会调整。拳头已在《曙光》专题页开放邮件订阅，将于 2027 年 1 月公开更多改版细节。
title_en: Riot Games Announces 'League of Legends: Dawn' Overhaul Featuring New Client and Map Visuals
content_en:
Riot Games has unveiled the first teaser for *League of Legends: Dawn*, a major overhaul of the flagship title scheduled for release in 2027. Announced on November 15 during the League of Legends World Championship, the initiative represents a comprehensive update to the existing game.

According to League Studio Head Meddler and Executive Producer Pabro, the overhaul will introduce a modernized client with an updated interface. Additionally, Summoner’s Rift will undergo visual remakes alongside gameplay adjustments.

Riot has opened email subscriptions on the official *Dawn* page, with further details expected in January 2027.

title_zh: Purism 公布 RISC-V 手机 Librem 5 v2，11 月 17 日公开众筹
content_zh:
Purism 公布了 Linux 手机 Librem 5 v2 的众筹方案。这款手机搭载进迭时空的八核 RISC-V 芯片 K1，运行 PureOS。单机众筹价为 1599 美元，活动将于 11 月 17 日面向公众开放，计划持续至 2027 年 2 月 15 日。

Librem 5 v2 采用 5.7 英寸屏幕，配备 8GB 内存和 128GB 存储。电池可拆卸，蜂窝和无线网络采用独立模块，用户可以用机身开关断开蜂窝网络、无线网络或摄像头和麦克风，也可以从存储卡启动系统。

11 月 12 日至 16 日，订阅 Purism 邮件的用户可以先行参与。项目目标为 2500 部，官方时间表分列开发板、测试机和零售机，预计 2028 年交付。
title_en: Purism Unveils RISC-V-Powered Librem 5 v2 Linux Phone Ahead of Crowdfunding Launch
content_en:
Purism has detailed its upcoming crowdfunding campaign for the Librem 5 v2, a Linux smartphone powered by SpacemiT’s octa-core RISC-V K1 chip and running PureOS. Priced at $1,599, the public campaign will run from November 17 through February 15, 2027, with early access available for email subscribers from November 12 to 16.

The Librem 5 v2 features a 5.7-inch display, 8GB of RAM, and 128GB of storage, alongside a removable battery and standalone wireless modules. For enhanced privacy, the device includes hardware kill switches for cellular networks, Wi-Fi, and camera/microphone components, as well as support for booting from a microSD card.

Purism aims to reach a campaign target of 2,500 units, with retail deliveries slated for 2028 following preliminary development and test unit releases.

title_zh: 谋先飞发布机器人仿真引擎 MotrixSim 1.0
content_zh:
中国团队谋先飞（Motphys）发布物理仿真引擎 MotrixSim 1.0，面向机器人训练和合成数据生成。引擎核心以 Rust 编写，支持在 CPU 上并行运行多个仿真环境，GPU 加速由商业版提供。

这套引擎可以模拟物体接触和摩擦，同时输出渲染画面和传感器数据。开发者可通过 Python 接口载入机器人模型、发送控制指令并读取每一步仿真的状态。
title_en: Motphys Launches MotrixSim 1.0 Physics Engine for Robotics and Synthetic Data
content_en:
Chinese technology team Motphys has launched MotrixSim 1.0, a physics simulation engine tailored for robotics training and synthetic data generation. Built on a Rust-based core, the engine supports running multiple parallel simulation environments on CPUs, while GPU acceleration is supported in its commercial edition.

MotrixSim 1.0 can simulate complex object contacts and friction while outputting both rendered visuals and sensor data. Developers can integrate robot models, issue control commands, and query step-by-step simulation states using a Python API.

title_zh: 《彩虹六号：围攻》新赛季 12 月 1 日上线，排位增设单排和双排队列
content_zh:
育碧在大阪公布了《彩虹六号：围攻》新赛季「庇护行动」，12 月 1 日上线。新赛季把排位分为单排／双排和弹性队列，两边各自记录段位。单排玩家只会进入单排／双排队列，双排则可能因地区和匹配时段被分到弹性队列。

育碧还重做了干员 Doc。他可以用新的装置远程治疗和救起倒地队友。新赛季内容将于 11 月 16 日先在测试服开放。
title_en: Rainbow Six Siege Unveils 'Operation Haven' with Solo/Duo Ranked Queues and Doc Rework
content_en:
Ubisoft has officially announced *Operation Haven*, the upcoming season for *Rainbow Six Siege*, set to launch on December 1 following a Test Server trial starting November 16.

The new season introduces a revamped Ranked system featuring separate Solo/Duo and Flex queues, each maintaining independent skill ranks. Solo players will strictly match within the Solo/Duo pool, while Duo players may occasionally merge into the Flex queue depending on region and matchmaking times.

Additionally, the operator Doc receives a major rework, equipping him with a new device to remotely heal and revive downed teammates.

title_zh: 华为云上线盘古 2.1 Pro，提供 512K 上下文和工具调用
content_zh:
华为云 MaaS 平台的发布公告显示，openPangu-2.1-Pro 于 11 月 15 日上线，面向西南－贵阳一区域提供预置服务，开发者可通过 API 接入。新版本支持 512K 上下文、可开关的深度思考、函数调用、前缀续写和前缀缓存。

华为云此前介绍，这一版本着重改进用于鸿蒙原生应用开发的 ArkTS 代码生成，并适配昇腾算子开发流程。按模型列表，2.1 Pro 和上一版 2.0 Pro 的上下文上限均为 512K，最大输出长度从 128K 提高到 384K。

同一区域的 openPangu-2.0-Flash 和 openPangu-2.0-Pro 服务定于北京时间 11 月 30 日零时下线。华为云在公告中分别建议改用 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 和 GLM-5.3。
title_en: Huawei Cloud Debuts openPangu-2.1-Pro with 512K Context and Expanded Output Capacity
content_en:
Huawei Cloud launched openPangu-2.1-Pro on November 15, making pre-configured API services available in its Southwest-Guiyang1 region. The updated model features a 512K context window, toggleable deep-thinking mode, function calling, prefix continuation, and prefix caching.

This release specifically enhances ArkTS code generation for native HarmonyOS app development while optimizing the Ascend operator workflow. While retaining the 512K context capacity of the previous 2.0 Pro model, version 2.1 Pro significantly expands the maximum output length from 128K to 384K tokens.

In addition, Huawei Cloud announced that openPangu-2.0-Flash and openPangu-2.0-Pro will be retired on November 30 at midnight (UTC+8). The platform recommends migrating to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 and GLM-5.3, respectively.

title_zh: 喜茶与合味道联名，主题店开启杯面打卡活动
content_zh:
11 月 14 日起，喜茶与日清合味道的联名主题店开启打卡活动。按喜茶公布的规则，在主题店前台点一杯「生打椰拉面」，并在小红书带指定话题发帖，可领取一杯合味道杯面。

联名饮品已于 11 月 13 日在全国门店上线。杯身借用了合味道的红白包装，杯内是椰子沙冰，芒果牛乳做成的拉面冻和水果玉米粒单独盛放，喝之前可以自己倒进杯里。两家还推出了小茶杯、冰箱贴和陶瓷拉面碗等周边。
title_en: Heytea Teams Up with Nissin Cup Noodles for Playful Noodle-Inspired Slushie
content_en:
Popular Chinese tea chain Heytea has partnered with Nissin Cup Noodles for a quirky brand collaboration, launching themed pop-up activities on November 14. Customers at designated store locations can score a free cup of Nissin instant noodles by ordering the signature collab drink and posting on Xiaohongshu with designated hashtags.

Rolled out across nationwide stores on November 13, the limited-edition coconut slushie comes packaged in Nissin's iconic red-and-white cup design. It features DIY toppings served on the side—mango-milk jelly shaped like ramen noodles and sweet corn kernels—which customers pour into the drink before consuming.

The collaboration also introduces exclusive branded merchandise, including mini tea cups, fridge magnets, and ceramic ramen bowls.

title_zh: 部分城市秋假连上周末，美团亲子门票预订量同比增 72%
content_zh:
部分城市把中小学秋假与周末连在一起，亲子套餐的预订量随之走高。美团 11 月 14 日披露，截至 13 日，游玩日期为 11 月 14 日至 15 日的「一大一小」「两大一小」等亲子门票预订量同比增长 72%，同期入住的亲子家庭房预订量同比增长 67%。

乐园和动物园是热门去处，乐园占美团近期亲子相关玩法订单的 64%。若把出行日期拉长到 11 月 14 日至 20 日，亲子游景点预订排名前三的分别是北京环球度假区、上海迪士尼度假区和万岁山武侠城。同一时段的美团机票订单中，热门目的地前三是成都、北京和上海。
title_en: Combined School Autumn Break Drives Surge in China's Family Travel Bookings
content_en:
As several Chinese cities align primary and middle school autumn breaks with weekends, family travel bookings have surged across the country. According to data released by Meituan on November 14, ticket bookings for family packages—such as "one adult, one child" or "two adults, one child"—for November 14–15 jumped 72% year-on-year, while family hotel room bookings grew by 67% over the same period.

Amusement parks and zoos emerged as the top choices for family outings, with theme parks accounting for 64% of recent family-related travel orders on the platform. Looking at travel trends from November 14 to 20, the most popular attractions include Universal Beijing Resort, Shanghai Disney Resort, and Wansui Mountain Martial Arts City, while Chengdu, Beijing, and Shanghai led as the top flight destinations.

title_zh: 部分电动自行车 3C 证书暂停，广州、武汉有车主上牌受阻
content_zh:
据中国之声报道，广州、武汉有消费者买到电动自行车后，在上牌时才发现对应车型的 3C 认证证书已暂停。广州消费者温女士 10 月 21 日购车，提交的整车合格证一度通过审核。她取消原预约、重新申请时，系统提示车辆的 3C 证书已暂停。

广州一处电动自行车登记服务点的工作人员表示，牌照登记会核验国家平台上的认证数据，服务点无法更改证书状态。中国之声还在武汉采访到遭遇类似问题的消费者。
title_en: E-Bike Buyers Face Registration Delays as 3C Certifications Are Suspended
content_en:
Electric bicycle buyers in Chinese cities including Guangzhou and Wuhan are encountering registration roadblocks after discovering that the 3C (China Compulsory Certification) certificates for their newly purchased vehicles have been suspended, according to a report by China National Radio.

In one instance, a Guangzhou buyer passed an initial certificate check after purchasing a bike on October 21, but was later flagged by the system when rescheduling her appointment because the vehicle's 3C status had changed to suspended. Local vehicle registration officials explained that license plate issuance automatically verifies data against the national certification platform, leaving local service centers unable to alter or override the certificate status. Similar cases have been reported in Wuhan.

title_zh: BLG 连赢三局击败 Gen.G，首夺《英雄联盟》全球总决赛冠军
content_zh:
北京时间 11 月 15 日，来自 LPL 的 BLG 在纽约巴克莱中心以 3 比 1 击败韩国 LCK 赛区的 Gen.G，拿下队史首座《英雄联盟》全球总决赛冠军。

Gen.G 先拿下首局，BLG 随后连赢三局。赛事官方将决赛最有价值选手（FMVP）颁给 BLG 中单 Knight。BLG 上一次打进全球总决赛冠军战是在 2024 年，当时以 2 比 3 负于 T1。今年两队在半决赛重逢，BLG 以 3 比 1 晋级。
title_en: BLG Defeats Gen.G 3-1 to Claim First League of Legends World Championship
content_en:
China’s Bilibili Gaming (BLG) defeated South Korea’s Gen.G 3-1 at the Barclays Center in New York on November 15, securing their first-ever League of Legends World Championship title.

After dropping the opening game, BLG rallied to win three consecutive matches to seal the victory. Mid-laner Knight was named the Finals Most Valuable Player (FMVP) for his outstanding performance. The victory comes after BLG's runner-up finish in 2024, where they lost 2-3 to T1 before defeating them 3-1 in this year's semifinals to reach the championship match.

title_zh: 首届 AI 音乐奖揭晓，虚拟歌手 Xania Monet 获三项年度奖
content_zh:
当地时间 11 月 13 日，首届 AI 音乐奖在洛杉矶举行。路透社现场报道，虚拟歌手 Xania Monet 拿下年度 AI 艺人、年度 AI 歌曲和年度 AI 专辑三项大奖，获奖歌曲为 R&B 单曲《How Was I Supposed to Know?》。

Xania Monet 由词作者 Telisha「Nikki」Jones 创造。Jones 在现场介绍，歌词由她自己写，再用 AI 把词谱成歌。主办方 Sonic Intelligence Academy 还设置了最佳 AI 辅助歌曲和最佳人类与 AI 混合创作歌曲等奖项，由该机构认证的 AI 音乐创作者投票选出获奖者。
title_en: Virtual Artist Xania Monet Dominates Inaugural AI Music Awards
content_en:
Virtual singer Xania Monet swept three top honors at the inaugural AI Music Awards in Los Angeles on November 13, securing AI Artist of the Year, AI Song of the Year, and AI Album of the Year for the R&B single *How Was I Supposed to Know?*.

Created by lyricist Telisha "Nikki" Jones, the project combines human-written lyrics with AI tools that compose the accompanying music and melody. Hosted by the Sonic Intelligence Academy, the awards recognize a spectrum of creative collaboration—from AI-assisted tracks to human-AI hybrids—with winners selected by academy-certified AI music creators.

title_zh: 欧洲电影奖公布提名，《祖国》以 11 项领跑
content_zh:
欧洲电影学院 11 月 14 日公布第 39 届欧洲电影奖提名。《祖国》获得 11 项提名，紧随其后的是获 10 项提名的《黑球》和获 5 项提名的《峡湾》。三部影片均入围最佳欧洲电影和最佳导演。

《祖国》由帕维乌·帕夫利科夫斯基执导，讲述作家托马斯·曼与女儿埃里卡在 1949 年驾车穿越战后德国的经历。哈维尔·卡尔沃和哈维尔·安布罗西执导的《黑球》，用三个男人的人生串起西班牙三个不同时期的故事。两部影片今年在戛纳并列获得最佳导演奖，《峡湾》则拿下金棕榈。

颁奖典礼将于 2027 年 1 月 16 日在雅典举行。
title_en: Pawlikowski’s 'Fatherland' Leads Nominations for 39th European Film Awards
content_en:
Paweł Pawlikowski’s historical drama *Fatherland* dominated the nominations for the 39th European Film Awards, securing 11 nods following the announcement by the European Film Academy on November 14. Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi’s *The Black Ball* followed closely with 10 nominations, while *The Fjord* earned five. All three features scored nods for Best European Film and Best Director.

*Fatherland* chronicles writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika on a 1949 road trip through post-war Germany, whereas *The Black Ball* weaves together the stories of three men across different eras in Spain. Both films previously shared the Best Director prize at this year's Cannes Film Festival, where *The Fjord* took home the prestigious Palme d'Or.

The 39th European Film Awards ceremony will be held in Athens on January 16, 2027.
